subscribe.title: Subscribe
subscribe.subtitle: Get notified when NightWorlds are available

build.title: Build amazing stuff
build.description: The server rules are designed to allow players to build anything they want. You can build a statue, a futurisic city or café – we don't mind. The main rule is not to grief.

communicate.title: Communicate with other players
communicate.description: One of the main priorities of NightWorlds is people. This rule works in all of NightWorlds. Together, we can make anything possible!

simplicity.title: There's no sense to overcomplicate things
simplicity.description: We target minimalism. Simplicity is the real power! Here you won't see webpages with design like in 2007. Also, we don't show tons of text at one in the actual game.

friends_online.title: Friends online
friends_online.subtitle: Your friends that are currently playing NightWorlds:
friends_online.nofriends: You have no friends at the time

subtitle.v_zero: You have no characters in NightWorlds

settings.name: Settings
settings.subtitle: Here you can change your account and game settings
settings.error: An error occurred while saving settings

ingamepassword.name: Change your in-game password
ingamepassword.helpertext: This is the password that you type in when you log in to NightWorlds Minecraft server by sending it in chat **without any commands, unlike most servers**.
ingamepassword.invalid: Invalid password. Password must be at least 8 characters long

sign-in.title: Sign In
sign-in.subtitle: Sign into your NightWorlds account to gain access to features and options unavailable in game

error.invalid: Unable to sign you in. Please check the credentials again
error.default: An unknown error has occurred. If this happens again, contact the administration

greeting.title: Welcome, {name}!
greeting.subtitle: Looks like it's your first time in NightWorlds! Let us help you to start playing as soon as possible

discord.title: Link your Discord account
discord.subtitle: Discord is a great messaging platform for gamers like us. Our players use it to talk with each other every day. Create a Discord account, or, if you have one, link it with your NightWorlds profile
discord.success: Your Discord account seems to be successfully linked!

nickname.title: Select a nickname
nickname.subtitle: If you have a Minecraft account, type its nickname in. If you don't have one, select an in-game nickname for yourself

error.length: Nicknames can only be between 3 and 16 characters
error.format: Your nickname contains some characters that are not permitted
error.occupied: This nickname is already used in NightWorlds

password.title: Protect your account
password.subtitle: Select a password for your NightWorlds account. It will be used only in game

error.length: Minimum length of password is 8 characters

additional.title: Your account is done!
additional.subtitle: There are things you can also do right now:
